steps.code:
# Parse old_songs.txt content
content = old_songs_file["content"]
lines = content.strip().split("\n")
old_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith("- "):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artists
        if " by " in line:
            title_part, artists_part = line.split(" by ", 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(",")]
            old_songs.append((title_part.strip(), set(artists)))
print(f"Old songs entries: {len(old_songs)}")
for t, a in old_songs:
    print(t, a)
